svg.title: FDM Newell cell-averaged convolution, Lepadatu multilayer stacking, and periodic image truncation
svg.desc: Two-panel diagram: (a) Newell 27-point vertex/edge/face stencil between source cell q and target cell p with 2N zero-padded FFT convolution preventing wraparound; (b) Lepadatu (2019) multilayer cross-layer convolution skipping vacuum gaps on native per-magnet grids versus 2D periodic image-count convergence and k=0 mode handling.
svg.text: FDM Demagnetization: Newell 27-Point Convolution, Multilayer Stacking, and Periodic Images
Cell-averaged Green kernels in open 2N FFT padding, vacuum-skipping multilayer pairs (Lepadatu 2019), and finite periodic image truncation
Newell Cell-Averaged Tensor (27-Point Stencil) and 2N Zero-Padded Open FFT
N_xx, N_yy, N_zz, N_xy, N_xz, N_yz
Crop [0 .. N−1] yields linear convolution without aliasing
Negation applied once before iFFT; pad length ≥ nsrc + ndst − 1
Lepadatu (2019) Multilayer Convolution (Vacuum-Skipping) vs Periodic Image Truncation
L fwd + L² pair products + L inv FFTs
Unequal hs,z ≠ hd,z: irregular Newell ℒ[f; hs, hd]
Multilayer mode is open-boundary only (PBC rejected fail-closed; no silent single-grid fallback)
Periodic Image Truncation & k = 0 Mode (20 × 20 × 2 nm Film)
FDM rejects periodic_airbox_k0; FEM periodic_airbox_k0 requires ≥ 1 open axis
